Split illustration contrasting ineffective and effective prayer based on Jesus' teaching. Left half (ineffective prayer): a proud man in ornate robes standing on a busy street corner, hands raised high, looking around to see if people are watching him. Right half (effective prayer): a person kneeling quietly inside a simple room with the door firmly closed, eyes closed in sincere prayer, with a window showing a calm sky.
